label: The partition of the shared question q f7: either a…, from Excluded middle as a general principle…
meaning: The owner's worldview argument for F7 (#1007), first step: exhaustiveness by the shared question, not a list of worldviews. From excluded middle alone, every interpretation satisfies F7 or lies in one of three ¬F7 cells: (a) potency with act in the same respect, (b) potency without capacity, (c) unexercised capacity without potency. cellsDenyF7 shows each cell contradicts F7; f7IffCellConstraints shows F7 is equivalent to the three constraints that exclude the cells (non-simultaneity, potency implies capacity, unexercised capacity is potency), so a floor that defeats every cell entails F7.
